description: How dark elf people talk to the captain at a station.

rumour: The Hollow Gate. Spacers call it the last good gate. We don't call it anything near strangers.
Everyone asks if the Courts made a deal. We stayed. Hear what you like in that.
Some say the Courts are houses struck from the Roll. Some say we struck ourselves. Don't ask which.
Humans ask where we came from. I say we don't count back that far. They write it down as if it meant something.
If you meet a grown hull, all spines, don't stop to look. Light elves leave the room. We just leave.
de-heard: I wouldn't say it twice, but
de-coda: You didn't hear it from me.
Might be true. Might be bait.
Stay out of it, if you're wise.
no-rumour: If I knew, I'd not say. I don't.
Nothing. Ask again if things change.
de-lead: I heard, and only if you can keep quiet:
de-workcoda: Take it or leave it quietly.
Ask no more than you need.
no-work: If there were, I'd not tell a stranger.
self: Why do you want to know? {role}. #de-life#
de-life: {system} is as good as any hole.
I've seen worse places. I live in some.
Some of it I'd rather not discuss.
Ask what I've done and I'll ask what you've paid.
When a hall closes, somebody has to say its name. I've said four.
I carry a key to a door I haven't found. It was my neighbour's.
de-toast: To the ones who didn't come back.
drink-again: One's enough. I'm watching my head.
Ask me tomorrow, if I'm here.
de-grudge: You've leverage. Don't get used to it.
haggle-no: Ask again and the deal goes.
haggle-offended: Last word you get from me. Leave.
